questions.justification: Domain plus one sign-sensitive branch; the trap is only in choosing the sign.

questions.key_step: Union = 80 + k and non-negativity of the seven Venn regions bounds k to 0..10.
questions.justification: Needs the unfamiliar viewpoint of a variable triple intersection and all region constraints; then match with a quadratic set. Two ideas linked.

questions.key_step: x = tan(theta): 3 theta lies in (pi/2, 3pi/4) so tan^-1(tan 3 theta) = 3 theta - pi.
questions.justification: Five inverse-trig terms each with a separate branch decision (one non-obvious: the -pi shift); long chain with precision risk although options exist.
